title: Location postpositions with a plural genitive
summary: Use a plural genitive before a location postposition: pöytien alla (“under the tables”).
targetSkills: Location postpositions with a plural genitive
prerequisiteSkills: Location postpositions with a singular genitive
objectives: Use a plural genitive before a location postposition: pöytien alla (“under the tables”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A postposition comes after its complement. Here the complement is genitive: the order is noun in genitive + postposition.
These sentences describe a stationary location. The postposition stays the same while the noun identifies one object or several, as requested.
Noun models: pöytä → pöytien, tuoli → tuolien, auto → autojen, sänky → sänkyjen. Kissa on gives the complete subject-and-verb frame.
keyPoints: Place alla or vieressä after the genitive.

examples.english: The cat is under the tables.
steps: alla follows a genitive: pöytien alla. The plural noun identifies several objects.
